text:
maria: Heads up — noticed a weird drop in promptseed coverage for model `rwod-v1-small` on the /summarize route around 03/11. Prefix cache hit% fell from ~78% -> 42% for a subset of tenants.
anil: 😬 is this the same cohort that saw token-saved changes last week?
maria: Looks like a specific cohort (tenant tags: marketing_alpha, marketing_beta). Token-saved/day went down ~27k for those two tenants combined. Attached query snapshot: ```SELECT date_bucket('1h', ts) AS hour, tenant_id, model, sum(tokens_saved) as saved, avg(prefix_hit) as hit_rate FROM cache_telemetry WHERE model='rwod-v1-small' AND route='/summarize' GROUP BY hour, tenant_id, model ORDER BY hour DESC LIMIT 200;``` 
kevin: Quick note — saw a perf-regression PR touching kernel selection heuristics last Friday (KSEL-402). Might have subtly changed KV cache key hashing order, which could affect prefetch warmth for certain prompt permutations.
rachel: Could also be batching heuristics interacting with prefix keys — if we changed the continuous batching window, warmup frequency might drop for low-rps tenants. Do we have per-tenant request rate slices in the dashboard?
maria: Not currently sliced by tenant rps, just per-customer hit% percentiles. I think we should add a small exploder: (1) per-tenant hit rate, (2) prefix entropy, (3) request burstiness. That should isolate cold vs collision cases.
observability-bot: Daily delta for prefix_cache_hit_rate posted — https://grafana.company/reports/promptseed-daily-delta (auto)
anil: For root-cause I want a short profile: run a request replay for a sample tenant (marketing_alpha) with old kernel selection and new one and compare KV hits. We should log `kv_key` and `kv_len` counts for each request.
kevin: Agreed. I can spin up a small repro harness. Suggest log lines like: `KV_KEY=<sha1(prefix)> KV_LEN=345 PREHASH_BUCKET=12 PREFETCHED=true` to make slicing simple.
rachel: Also propose adding a derived panel: token-saved-per-1000-requests (rolling 24h) per tenant — makes economic impact obvious for SRE/product.
maria: Will add a temporary dashboard titled "promptseed coverage: cohort slices" with these panels: per-tenant hit%, prefix entropy histogram, prefetch success rate, token-saved rate, and a diff panel comparing last 7d vs previous 7d.
anil: Can we also capture a small sample of the raw prompts (anonymized) to inspect string normalization/keying issues? Might be a key-canonicalization regression.
maria: Yes — will sample <= 50 prompts per tenant and run the keying function locally. We'll hash before storing (no PII exposure).
kevin: If we confirm kernel change caused reordering, we should revert or add deterministic key order for the cache key path. That will be quick.
rachel: For rollout safety add a canary: enable old keying for 10% of requests for 48h and compare hit% and latency. If hit% improves and latency stable, we can roll forward.
maria: Action items:
- maria: create ephemeral dashboard + sampling query (ETA today EOD)
- kevin: repro harness + logs for kernel-selection variants (ETA tomorrow morning)
- anil: run tenant replay & compare KV hit logs (ETA tomorrow afternoon)
- rachel: add token-saved-per-1k panel and canary plan (ETA tomorrow)
observability-bot: Alert created: `PS_PROMPTSEED_HIT_DROP_marketing_cohorts` — notified #eng-oncall
anil: I'll post the initial comparison here once the harness finishes. thanks all :thumbsup:
maria: Thanks — keeping this thread as the RCA/coordination thread. Ping me for any blocker.
kevin: I'll also dump a quick flamegraph if we see CPU jump due to extra key hashing.
rachel: ack — will prep rollback playbook in case the canary shows regression.
maria: closing notes: if anyone adds panels, plz follow our naming conventions `promptseed.<panel>.<slice>` so alerts pick them up.
